context: The agent is given a Docusaurus v2 project scaffold and asked to migrate its configuration files to be compatible with Docusaurus v3. The grader checks that the updated package.json, tsconfig.json, and docusaurus.config.js reflect the correct v3 package versions, TypeScript config package, engines field, and Prism import style.

checklist.name: @docusaurus/core version
checklist.description: inputs/package.json specifies @docusaurus/core at ^3.0.0 (or a higher ^3.x range)

checklist.name: TypeScript version
checklist.description: inputs/package.json specifies typescript at ~5.2.2 (or higher ~5.x) in devDependencies

checklist.name: engines field added
checklist.description: inputs/package.json contains an "engines" field with "node": ">=18.0" (or a stricter lower bound like >=18.x)

checklist.name: Prism themes destructuring import
checklist.description: inputs/docusaurus.config.js uses `const {themes} = require('prism-react-renderer')` instead of the old `require('prism-react-renderer/themes/...')` path-based imports

checklist.name: additionalLanguages configured
checklist.description: inputs/docusaurus.config.js includes an additionalLanguages array in the prism config block (e.g. containing 'bash', 'diff', or 'json')

checklist.name: Old tsconfig package removed
checklist.description: inputs/package.json does NOT still list @tsconfig/docusaurus as a dependency or devDependency
